title: Human Spinal Cord Nuclei Isolation
author: Abbas Rizvi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9yhh7t6

steps.title: Prepare 10× Stock Salt Solution
steps.instruction: Raise the volume to 50 mL with water; store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks. Mix 2.5 mL 1 M CaCl₂ (final 50 mM), 1.5 mL 1 M magnesium acetate (final 30 mM), 5 mL 1 M Tris pH 7.8 (final 100 mM), and 35 µL 14.3 M 2‑mercaptoethanol (final 10 mM).

steps.title: Prepare 1× Homogenization Buffer
steps.instruction: Raise to 10 mL with water; keep on ice and prepare fresh each time. Add 1 mL 10× Stock Salt Solution, 1.6 mL 2 M sucrose (final 320 mM), 200 µL 5 mM EDTA (final 0.1 mM), 100 µL 10 % NP‑40 (final 0.1 %), 10 µL 100 mM PMSF (final 100 µM), and optionally 5 µL 5 mg mL⁻¹ DAPI.

steps.title: Prepare 50 % OptiPrep Solution
steps.instruction: Raise to 50 mL with water; store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks. Mix 25 mL OptiPrep, 5 mL 10× Stock Salt Solution, and 8 mL 2 M sucrose.

steps.title: Prepare 29 % OptiPrep Solution
steps.instruction: Raise to 50 mL with water; store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks. Mix 14.5 mL OptiPrep, 5 mL 10× Stock Salt Solution, and 8 mL 2 M sucrose.

steps.title: Add Homogenization Buffer to Dounce
steps.instruction: On ice (0 °C), add 4 mL 1× Homogenization Buffer to a clean 7 mL dounce homogenizer. If using NeuN antibody, add 20 µL primary labeled NeuN antibody (1:500 final dilution).

steps.title: Cut Tissue and Transfer
steps.instruction: Cut four frozen spinal‑cord tissue slices ~0.2 mm thick and place them into the dounce homogenizer.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Perform 15 strokes with the loose pestle followed by 20 strokes with the tight pestle, avoiding bubble formation.

steps.title: Filter Homogenate
steps.instruction: Pass the homogenate through a 100 µm mesh into a fresh 15 mL tube; rinse the mesh with 1 mL 1× Homogenization Buffer and collect the rinse in the same tube.

steps.title: Incubate Homogenate
steps.instruction: Incubate the filtered homogenate on ice for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Add 50 % OptiPrep and Mix
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 50 % OptiPrep (~4.5 mL) to the incubated homogenate, then invert gently but thoroughly to mix, avoiding bubbles; the mixture becomes a 25 % OptiPrep solution.

steps.title: Layer Over 29 % OptiPrep
steps.instruction: In a swinging‑bucket ultracentrifuge tube (e.g., Beckman #344058), gently layer 10 mL of the 29 % OptiPrep solution beneath the 25 % OptiPrep mixture.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge Gradient
steps.instruction: Spin in a swinging‑bucket rotor at 10,100 g (≈7,400 rpm in SW‑28 Beckman rotor) for 30 minutes (00:30:00) at 4 °C with acceleration and brake set to maximum (setting 9). Nuclei pellet at the tube bottom; do not disturb the gradient.

steps.title: Remove Upper OptiPrep Layers
steps.instruction: Using a 1 mL pipette, carefully aspirate the 25 % OptiPrep layer from the top; if a myelin coating is present, remove it first. Then “slurp” the remaining solution by aspirating bubbles (≈50 % solution + 50 % air) until ~5 mL remains. Finally, remove the remaining ~5 mL in 1 mL increments without re‑using the tip, taking care not to disturb the nuclei pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend Nuclei
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of your chosen buffer (e.g., PBS + 0.1 % BSA) directly against the bottom of the ultracentrifuge tube, forcefully expel, pipet up and down to fully resuspend nuclei, and transfer the suspension to an ice‑cold 1.5 mL tube.
